description: SMPTE bars seen only through the letters of a bold white title, `SCOR`, over a near-black bed: a text matte. Expect the four letters, large and centred, filled with the bars' vertical colour stripes, and near-black everywhere else. The title's own white is never drawn — only its shape. What a wrong render looks like: white letters means the matte clip was drawn on its own track; bars across the whole frame means the matte was ignored; letters filled with a flat colour means the wrong clip was masked.
